notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA Wisconsin list is the only source found that names this tower (county, coordinates, type, gone). It is not on the NHLR Wisconsin list. Two WebSearch queries found no build, builder, staffing, removal or site-today record; the story uses statewide context only (WPR, Wikipedia, 2019 chapter report). Still needed: Rusk County Historical Society, Wisconsin Historical Society Architecture and History Inventory site file, DNR records, and a current site check.
